收劍前先看一眼身後。沒人，好。: Check behind me before sheathing. No one there — good.
劍穗纏住了，難怪一直拉著手。: The sword tassel's tangled — no wonder it kept tugging at my hand.
繩結沒鬆，行囊也還在。: The knot's still tight, and my pack's still there.
出劍的位置比剛才寬多了。: There's much more room to draw my sword now than before.
劍身還在嗡嗡響，等它停了再收。: The blade's still humming — I'll wait for it to settle before sheathing.
終於聽得見自己的呼吸了。: I can finally hear my own breathing again.
水袋放哪裡去了？在這裡。: Where'd I put the water skin? Ah, here it is.
肩膀拉到了，抬手有點痛。: Pulled a muscle in my shoulder — raising my arm hurts a little.
劍先收好，免得走路碰到牆。: I'll sheathe my sword first, so it doesn't knock against the wall as I walk.
還有一段樓梯要走。: There's still a stretch of stairs left to climb.
這塊地板會滑，回來時得記住。: This part of the floor is slippery — I need to remember that on the way back.
乾糧算少了，這一劍撐不起來。: Rations are running low — I don't have the strength for that strike.
剩下的力氣不夠使這招。: Not enough strength left to pull off this move.
水袋還有，飯糰沒了。: Still have some water left, but the rice balls are gone.
得省著用剩下的飯糰。: I need to ration what's left of the rice balls.
這一劍太吃力，先緩一口氣再出。: That strike takes too much out of me — I'll catch my breath before the next one.
再出這招，力氣就不夠了。: One more use of this move, and I won't have the strength left.
先換一招省力的。: I'll switch to something that costs less energy.
手抖得快握不住劍了。: My hand's shaking so much I can barely hold the sword.
腿使不上力，得扶著牆。: My legs won't hold — I need to lean on the wall.
眼前有些模糊，不能再往前衝。: My vision's blurring — I can't push forward any further.
